Mutation-tested against the 351e6997c DAWN set (passes), the first Frequency capture with no rail masks (fails), synthetic Frequency sets with both rails masked (passes), the right rail unmasked (fails), the right rail panel-masked with gaps (fails), and /feed's rails masked (fails).
